title: Built a Chess RPG prototype using AI for 100% of code, art, and audio (packaged with Tauri). Free demo live on Itch.io!
author: Disastrous_Command68
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I wanted to share a prototype I built called Tactical Chess. I don't have a background in programming, art, or audio, so I took on the role of game director and used AI for the execution side.

The game is built with frontend web tech and packaged into a desktop build using Tauri. My workflow was focused on designing the game mechanics, structuring the combat rules, iterating prompts, and guiding the AI through debugging logic errors until the turn-based loop worked.

The gameplay is a mix of chess grid positioning with tactical RPG mechanics like unit skills, passive buffs, and energy management. My long-term goal is to take what I learn here to eventually build a full tactical RPG inspired by Final Fantasy Tactics.

You can download the free PC demo on Itch.io:[https://zerosoac.itch.io/chess-tactics](https://zerosoac.itch.io/chess-tactics)

Since the entire codebase was generated through AI, there are definitely edge cases and bugs to squash. I would love to hear your thoughts on the mechanics, the workflow, and any issues you run into while testing!
